name: roleplaying-agents git history: measure
goal: Measure what fills roleplaying-agents' 113 GB .git (objects, largest blobs/paths, non-pack stores incl. LFS/submodules, refs, history shape, remote/LFS, worktrees/active users) and write a findings doc with ranked cleanup options; modify nothing.

tasks.name: Measure and write findings
tasks.description: No tests required: read-only measurement and a doc. Exact commands: human plan Task 1 Steps 1-7. Read-only git only (no gc/prune/repack/filter/ref deletion/fetch/push). Bash timeout 1800000 on rev-list/cat-file, git log --all and git lfs ls-files --all.

steps.description: M1 df (>=5 GiB free), count-objects, pack sizes, du -sh of every .git/* entry (lfs, modules, worktrees, lost-found, filter-repo, logs), ls .git/filter-repo
M2 largest blobs + per-path totals with full space-containing paths (awk joins fields 5..NF) per human plan Step 2 (timeout 1800000); explain blob-total vs pack-total gap as reflog-only/unreachable
steps.expected: Top 40 blobs, top 30 paths, total recorded.

steps.description: M3 refs per namespace grouped by first 3 segments, broken refs, reflog size, stash count per human plan Step 3
M4 history shape + f6f0d3134 branch containment per human plan Step 4
M5 remote, LFS (git lfs ls-files --all count + exit code, timeout 1800000), upstream tracking per human plan Step 5
M6 worktrees + active processes per human plan Step 6
